source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Μερκούριος ο νηστευτής»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole content is a cross-reference: «Για τον Όσιο Μερκούριο τον νηστευτή βλέπε στις 24 Νοεμβρίου». **So the row records this day, which is the day the page itself keeps him on, and the 24 Νοεμβρίου page is named here and in the report**: a reader of that day will find his life there and should upgrade this folder rather than make a second one. The corpus's two other men of the name are neither of them this one: Mercurius the great martyr and soldier, kept on the Romanian 25 November, and Mercurius one of the twelve tribunes, with a venerated Greek row on 24 May. No year, so no `dates` object; no place, so no location. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
